= Introspection facilities

This module provides ways to query and reflectively use bindings defined in modules. Mostly useful for creating tooling, such as documentation generators or test runners.


[code,lisp]
----
(requires "builtin/introspection.lisp")
----



== +<module>+

[.islisp-kind]_class_

.Superclasses
* <object>



Class representing an ISLISP module.

== +lookup-module+

[.islisp-kind]_function_

[subs="+quotes"]
----
(lookup-module path) => <module>
----



Returns reference to a module defined at _path_ as an instance of *<module>*, or *nil* if it doesn't exist. Uses same rules as provide form.
An error shall be signaled if  _path_ is not a string (error-id. _domain-error_).

== +lookup-module-documentations+

[.islisp-kind]_function_

[subs="+quotes"]
----
(list-module-documentations module) => <vector>
----



Returns all documentation entries registered in _module_. Each entry is itself a vector length of 3, containing namespace, name, and documentation alist. See *documentation* method for details on its structure.
An error shall be signaled if  _module_ is not an instance of *<module>* (error-id. _domain-error_).
